map.根据 AJCC 第8版口腔癌 TNM 分期标准，输入原发肿瘤(T)、区域淋巴结(: Stages oral cancer per the AJCC 8th edition TNM criteria, entering the primary tumor (T), regional lymph nodes (N) and distant metastasis (M).
map.原发肿瘤 T 分期录入，结合肿瘤大小与浸润深度，工具给出 T 分级。: Enter the primary tumor T stage, combining tumor size and depth of invasion, and the tool gives the T grade.
map.区域淋巴结评估 N 分期，提示单侧/双侧与包膜外侵犯影响。: Assess regional lymph nodes for N staging, noting the effect of unilateral versus bilateral and extranodal extension.
map.远处转移 M 录入后输出完整临床分期与治疗提示。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛: After entering distant metastasis M, it outputs the complete clinical stage and treatment notes. (The results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examinations, radiographic assessment such as periapical films or CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists or periodontists; if you have tooth pain, gum bleeding, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, seek care promptly at a proper hospital dental department.)
map.：输入：T1（≤2cm，浸润≤5mm）、N0、M0\n输出：临床 I 期；若浸润:
Input: T1 (2 cm or less, invasion 5 mm or less), N0, M0
Output: clinical stage I; if the depth of invasion is over 5 mm or there is node involvement the stage rises sharply and imaging plus biopsy are needed.

map.AJCC 第 8 版有什么更新？: What is new in AJCC 8th Edition?
map.更强调肿瘤浸润深度、部位（口咽 HPV 状态）与淋巴结包膜外侵犯对分期的影响；口: It puts more emphasis on depth of invasion, site (oropharyngeal HPV status) and extranodal extension for staging; in oral cancer the T stage is refined by depth of invasion.
map.和筛查工具(kouqiangai-tnm)区别？: How is it different from the screening tool (kouqiangai-tnm)?
map.本工具按 AJCC 第 8 版标准做 T/N/M 组合分期，偏专业分型；筛查工具: This tool does T/N/M combination staging per the AJCC 8th edition standard, which leans toward professional classification, while the screening tool leans toward symptoms and care-seeking prompts; the two complement each other.
map.分期能决定治疗方案吗？: Does staging determine the treatment plan?
map.分期是治疗规划的重要依据，但最终方案需多学科（外科、放疗、肿瘤）结合病理与全身情: Staging is an important basis for treatment planning, but the final plan requires multiple disciplines (surgery, radiotherapy, oncology) combining pathology and the overall condition.
